confirmedSourceSemantics.resolution: Rows 13-28 are cyclic group rows for groups 501-516; horizontal merged discipline blocks expand to each covered calendar date under C01.
An asterisk applies second-shift time only to the first day of the corresponding starred cycle; remaining cycle dates use first-shift time from the lower reference table.
Blocks labelled 'экзамен' without a concrete discipline and exact time are exam-period markers and do not generate daily events.
